description: In a nonempty dense linear order without endpoints, the specified positive-clause output holds exactly when the original clause has a witness for the eliminated variable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.orderClause_correct.{u} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M]
  [DenselyOrdered M] [NoMinOrder M] [NoMaxOrder M] [Nonempty M]
  (c : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Atom true (n + 1))) (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize (fun a b => a < b)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.orderClause c) x ↔
    ∃ a,
      ∀ t ∈ c,
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Formula.realizeAtom (fun a b => a < b) t (Fin.snoc x a)
